question: When was the Forest (Conservation) Amendment Bill introduced in the Lok Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wed Mar 29 2023 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Forest (Conservation) Amendment Bill** was introduced in the Lok Sabha on **Wed Mar 29 2023**.
 
• This bill aims to amend the **Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980**, which provides for the conservation of forests and matters connected therewith.
 
• Such amendments are crucial for addressing contemporary challenges related to forest conservation, climate change, and sustainable development.
 
• Legislative changes ensure that the legal framework governing forest conservation is robust and capable of meeting the current and future needs of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980** was enacted to provide for the conservation of forests and to regulate the diversion of forest land for non-forestry purposes.
 
• It aims to balance the need for development with the need to conserve forests by imposing stringent restrictions on the dereservation of forests and the use of forest land for non-forest purposes.
 
• The Act has been instrumental in preventing the indiscriminate destruction of forests and has contributed significantly to forest conservation in India.
 
• Over the years, various amendments have been made to the Act to address emerging challenges and to strengthen forest conservation efforts.
